items.title: Jio IPO falls short of record payday for bankers despite mega issue
items.description: Jio Platforms is paying 19 banks about ₹196 crore in fees for its $3.1 billion IPO, just 0.65% of the issue size, as fierce competition squeezes investment banking earnings.

items.title: Anthropic IPO filing warns of power, water and climate-related risks
items.description: Anthropic warns that opposition to AI data centres, rising power and water demand, climate change and tighter regulatory scrutiny could raise costs and hurt its reputation

items.title: Anthropic opens books on AI's explosive growth and staggering costs
items.description: Anthropic's IPO filing highlights rapid revenue growth, mounting AI development costs and safety risks as the Claude maker prepares to list on Nasdaq amid investor concerns over AI valuations
